subject: Noventix Private Onramp — auth, routing, and egress walkthrough
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@noventix.com>, Rajiv Menon <r.menon@noventix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Noventix Private Onramp — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks again for the call earlier, Ellen/Rajiv — good session. This thread is a short recap and an agreed owner/action list so everybody has a single source of truth. High-level outcome: Noventix is aligned to evaluate Redwood Private for inference-on-prem/connected-VPC with requirements around private egress, DNS resolution through your VPC, and mTLS between your proxies and our customer-facing ingress.

Key technical points we covered:
- SDK: youll use the Redwood SDK (python/node) during initial POC; well provide an auth snippet for JWT-based service tokens or short-lived OIDC tokens depending on your KMS setup.
- Auth: primary plan is OIDC + mTLS client certs for control-plane ops; API-level requests from app servers will use short-lived bearer tokens issued by your IdP.
- Routing: requests should route to the dedicated/private endpoint we provision; we can expose either a VPC endpoint (gateway) or a reverse-proxy in your subnet.
- Structured output / tool calling: well demo structured-output schemas (JSON schema enforcement) during the POC; tool-calling will be via a signed webhook pattern — details in attached sdk-auth-snippets.md.
- Embeddings / rerankers: data will be sent to our embeddings pipeline via a private egress path; reranker runs colocated in the private pool to avoid public egress.

Immediate action items (owners):
1) Noventix: confirm the preferred connectivity model — VPC endpoint (preferred) or reverse-proxy (fallback). Owner: Ellen. ETA: 2026-09-24.
2) Redwood (Ben): provide the list of egress IP ranges and TLS cert requirements for allowlist. Attachment: egress-ip-list.csv. ETA: 2026-09-22 EOD.
3) Noventix: confirm IdP token flow (OIDC client credentials vs. mTLS+JWT). Owner: Rajiv. ETA: 2026-09-23.
4) Redwood (Karthik): share SDK auth snippets and example structured output schema for reranker calls. Attachment: sdk-auth-snippets.md and noventix-mutual-action-plan.pdf. ETA: 2026-09-22.

Ive attached a one-page mutual action plan for timelines and owners. Ben & Karthik — please flag if anything above is wrong or if Ive missed critical items from the call. Ellen/Rajiv — happy to hop on a follow-up technical screen next week (30–45 minutes) to step through the cert rotation, firewall rules, and sample SDK flow with a sandbox model.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachments: noventix-mutual-action-plan.pdf (PDF, 1 page), egress-ip-list.csv (CSV, 1 row placeholder), sdk-auth-snippets.md (text)
From: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@noventix.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@noventix.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Noventix Private Onramp — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Lauren — that recap is perfect and mirrors our notes. Quick clarifications from our infra team:

- Connectivity: Noventix would like the VPC endpoint option if possible. That keeps our DNS and egress policies simpler.
- Firewall/Allowlist: we need the canonical list of IPs and the certificate CA thumbprint that Redwoods ingress will present so our ops team can pre-authorize the connection.
- IdP: we run Keycloak; client-credentials via OIDC is our preference, but we may need an mTLS fallback for some service accounts that cannot call the IdP directly.

Can you put the IP/CIDR list and sample cert details in a CSV or text file (so our ticketing system can ingest it)? If you can get that by EOD PDT today, well open the change ticket and lock a 9/27 tech screen.

—Rajiv
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Noventix
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@noventix.com>, Ellen Park <ellen@noventix.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Noventix Private Onramp — post-call recap and next steps

Rajiv — thanks. Ive attached the initial egress IP row (egress-ip-list.csv) and included the CA thumbprint well present on TLS. Quick notes on the items you called out:

- VPC endpoint model: we will provide an AWS PrivateLink endpoint with a single NLB in our customer-facing region. You will see the NLB IPs in the CSV. If you prefer a private reverse-proxy in your subnet, we can demo that too but PrivateLink reduces NAT/egress complexity.
- TLS / mTLS: control-plane calls (management, cert rotation) will use mTLS and our ops certs; data-plane inference API calls can be secured by short-lived bearer tokens from your Keycloak OIDC or by client certs if you need mutual TLS.
- SDK & structured output: Karthik attached a short sample for structured JSON schema enforcement for tool-calling and the embeddings + reranker flow. Were planning to run the reranker within the private pool so embeddings never leave the private path.

Action items updated:
- Ben: upload a CSV with NLB IPs + CA thumbprint (attached).
- Karthik: include a minimal python sample showing OIDC token exchange + SDK call (see sdk-auth-snippets.md).
- Lauren: schedule 9/27 tech screen with our infra + SRE and Noventixs infra team.

If that timeline works for you, Ill reserve 9/27 10:00–10:45 PT on calendars and include the pre-read.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@noventix.com>, Ellen Park <ellen@noventix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Noventix Private Onramp — post-call recap and next steps

Sounds good — confirmed: Ben has uploaded the IPs and cert thumbprint (see attachment). Karthik has pushed the SDK snippets to the drive link in the pre-read. I booked the tech screen for 2026-09-27 10:00 PT and invited Noventix infra, Redwood SRE (Ben), and our integration lead (Karthik). Calendar invite sent.

One more ask for Noventix before the tech screen: if you can provide a sample DNS resolution plan (how your VPC resolves external hostnames — e.g., Route53 Resolver, outbound proxy, or DNS forwarding) that will help our SREs prepare. If you dont have one, a quick note of the outbound proxy / NAT behavior is sufficient.

Well use this tech screen to:
- validate VPC endpoint acceptance tests (connectivity + TLS handshake),
- walk through OIDC token flow and fallback mTLS,
- run a small SDK demo that exercises structured output and an embeddings->reranker call,
- and confirm the mutual action plan dates so the POC can start the week after.

Thanks again — see you on 9/27,
Lauren
